name: zmodel_material_find_or_clone
description: zModel_Material::FindOrClone returns a reusable material from the MRU cache or active pool, and clones into the active material pool when no reusable entry exists.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this material lookup helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x480ca0 validates the MRU g_zModel_MatlReuseCache check through zModel_Material::CompareForReuse, active-list traversal from g_zModel_MatlActiveHeadIndex using zModel_MaterialSlot.nextPoolIndex, returning the matching slot material, and cloning/storing the clone into g_zModel_MatlReuseCache when no reusable entry exists.
The native smoke verifies cache reuse, active-list reuse with userTag promotion through CompareForReuse, and no-match cloning into the active pool with cache update.
